ChatGPT said:ChatGPT

You need to modify your existing Projects.jsx component so that it displays a real project image instead of the ET initials, without disturbing your existing layout and animations.

1. Replace your complete Projects.jsx

JavaScript

import { projects } from '../data/portfolio';
import TechChip from './TechChip';

export default function Projects() {
  return (
    <section id="projects">
      <div className="in">
        <h2>Featured Project</h2>

        <p className="sub">
          Developing intelligent employee transportation
          solutions with scalable MERN-stack SaaS architecture.
        </p>

        <div className="g1" id="pj">
          {projects.map((p) => (
            <article
              className="card prj"
              data-tilt
              key={p.id}
            >
              {/* Project Image - replaces ET initials */}
              <div className="th prj-image-wrap">
                <img
                  src={p.image}
                  alt={p.imageAlt || p.title}
                  className="prj-image"
                  loading="lazy"
                />
              </div>

              {/* Project Details */}
              <div className="prj-details">
                <div className="jh">
                  <h3>{p.title}</h3>
                  <span className="chip">{p.period}</span>
                </div>

                <p>{p.description}</p>

                <h4>Key Features</h4>

                <ul className="ft">
                  {p.features.map((f) => (
                    <li key={f}>{f}</li>
                  ))}
                </ul>

                <h4>Technologies</h4>

                <div className="tech-list">
                  {p.tech.map((t) => (
                    <TechChip
                      key={t.id}
                      id={t.id}
                      label={t.label}
                    />
                  ))}
                </div>
              </div>
            </article>
          ))}
        </div>
      </div>
    </section>
  );
}

2. Add these CSS styles

CSS
.prj-image-wrap {
  overflow: hidden;
  position: relative;
  padding: 0 !important;
  min-width: 0;
  min-height: 410px;
  border-radius: 14px;
  background: #0b1934;
}

.prj-image {
  display: block;
  width: 100%;
  height: 100%;
  min-height: 410px;
  object-fit: cover;
  object-position: center;
  transition: transform 0.7s ease;
}

.prj:hover .prj-image {
  transform: scale(1.05);
}

.prj-details {
  min-width: 0;
}

.tech-list {
  display: flex;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  gap: 7px;
}

@media (max-width: 768px) {
  .prj-image-wrap {
    min-height: 250px;
  }

  .prj-image {
    min-height: 250px;
  }
}
